Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.     An overview of this role  
 As a Senior Revenue Operations Manager at GitLab, you'll own work the whole go-to-market organization relies on: the policies and processes that govern how we sell and book deals, our global forecasting process, and the Chief Revenue Officer (CRO) operating cadence. You'll report to the Senior Manager, Sales Operations, and work closely with sales leadership, other Revenue Strategy & Operations teams, Finance, Deal Desk, Product, and Data. 
 This is a senior individual contributor role. You'll bring experience running a forecast process day to day and a practical understanding of how a sales organization works. You'll work independently to take a problem from "something looks off in the numbers" to a fix that sticks. 
 GitLab is all-remote, and most of our work happens in writing. Clear, concise documentation is a big part of this job. 
  What you’ll do  
 
 Own the policies that define how deals are booked, credited, and forecasted, including bookings rules, opportunity netting, and sales stages and exit criteria. Write them, get them approved, and make sure the field understands what changed and why. 
 Identify process problems before they affect the numbers. Validate and size the problem with data, find the root cause, and drive the fix with the right team, whether that's Revenue Systems, Deal Desk, Enablement, or compensation. 
 Partner with Revenue Systems to build policy into system rules, validations, and alerts, reducing manual reviews and after-the-fact corrections. 
 Improve forecast methodology by tracking actual results against the forecast, explaining variances, and changing processes that aren't working. Partner with Finance and Revenue Analytics to reconcile the field forecast with the finance outlook. 
 Own the weekly forecast readout for the CRO and sales leadership, keeping it short and focused on decisions. Bring the forecasting and policy perspective into annual planning. 
 Coordinate the CRO organization's weekly, monthly, and quarterly reviews, metrics, and follow-ups. Measure their impact on pipeline hygiene, data quality, forecast accuracy, and bookings, and change the cadence where it isn't working. 
 Work with other Revenue Strategy & Operations teams, Finance, Product, Data, and Enablement to deliver changes from the first draft through field adoption. Keep cadence documentation current so the organization knows what happens when, who owns it, and what's expected. 
 Mentor others on the team and improve how we document and run our processes. 
 
  What you’ll bring  
 
 Experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations

jd_text:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. 
 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems.  Co-create the future with us  as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. 
 * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.     An overview of this role  
 As a Senior Backend Engineer on the Duo Chat team, focused on Chat Engine, you'll build the core AI capabilities behind GitLab Duo Chat, the natural-language and agentic interface to the GitLab DevSecOps platform. Much of your work will involve building flow components and agentic flows in the Flow Registry, the Python framework built on LangGraph within our Duo Workflow Service that powers agentic chat, and integrating them with the GitLab Rails monolith. 
 You'll own complex backend features from start to finish across both services. You'll integrate large language models and orchestrate multi-agent flows so customers can work faster and more securely across the software development lifecycle. This work sits where GitLab's core platform meets its AI strategy, and reliability, performance, and answer quality directly shape the customer experience. 
  What you’ll do  
 
 Design and build flow components and agentic flows in the Flow Registry using Python and LangGraph within the Duo Workflow Service. These reusable building blocks power agentic Duo Chat and, increasingly, other AI features across GitLab. 
 Develop, ship, and maintain backend features for GitLab Duo Chat across the Python Duo Workflow Service and the GitLab Rails monolith in a secure, well-tested, and performant way. 
 Integrate new generative AI models, providers, tools, and multi-agent orchestration patterns into Duo Chat to expand its capabilities and improve answer quality. 
 Design, implement, and review GraphQL and Representational State Transfer (REST) application programming interfaces (APIs) and related monolith logic, including chat entry points, permissions, and foundational-flow registration. Keep contracts with frontend clients and host systems reliable and clear. 
 Improve debugging, observability, and test coverage using pytest, RSpec, and related frameworks; track and improve latency, error rates, and test coverage so AI-powered chat workflows stay reliable at scale. 
 Collaborate with Product, User Experience (UX), frontend, and AI specialists to refine requirements and deliver high-quality improvements through iteration. 
 Document standards, patterns, and learnings with other engineers, raising the bar for safe AI integration and evidence-driven engineering. 
 Participate in Tier 2 on-call rotations to troubleshoot production issues, contribute to root cause analysis, and strengthen resiliency. 
 
  What you’ll bring  
 
 Significant experience building and maintaining production Python backends, including APIs, data models, and asynchronous or long-running workloads.

title: 半导体行业采购商务经理
jd_text:
1.负责服务器核心部件及芯片项目商务管理工作；
2.研究&分析服务器部件端到端成本及市场发展趋势，参与制定采购策略；
3.负责服务器部件项目运作及商务管理，包括进度管理、需求管理、商务谈判、价格管理、合同管理及执行过程中的问题管理；
4.落实采购成本控制目标，降低综合采购成本。

title: 腾讯游戏-供应链安全治理高级工程师-供应链安全
jd_text:
1.作为企业供应商安全治理架构师和领域专家，负责 IEG 企业供应链、供应商、外包及合研安全治理的整体规划、制度建设、流程落地和持续运营；
2.建立覆盖供应商准入、风险分级、合同安全条款、审计权、保密责任、合研空间、驻场人员、终端、账号、数据、日志审计、整改闭环、应急处置和退出清理的安全管理体系；
3.设计并落地供应商分级分类模型，按服务类型、接触资产、数据类型、系统权限、人员规模、办公模式、研发协作方式等维度识别供应商和合研场景风险等级；
4.制定供应商准入评估、合研场景安全评估、证据核验、风险评分、整改要求、准入结论、例外审批和风险接受机制；
5.协同采购、法务、风控、业务、行政、IT、安全运营等团队，将安全要求嵌入供应商引入、续约、变更、驻场、合研、退出等全生命周期流程；
6.建设供应商安全制度、评估模板、证据目录、合同条款库、风险接受模板、审计检查清单和整改闭环规则；
7.跟踪高风险供应商、外包团队和合研场景的安全问题整改，推动责任确认、时限管理、复测验证和闭环归档；
8.负责重大供应链及合研安全风险判断、例外评估、风险接受建议、管理升级和复盘改进；
9.建设供应商安全指标体系和管理看板，定期输出风险态势、准入情况、整改进展、例外事项和资源投入报告；
10.推动供应商安全治理从线下人工检查升级为系统化、流程化、可审计的长期运营能力。

title: 高级/资深交互设计师（归唐）
jd_text:
1. 本科及以上学历，工业设计，交互专业，三年以上交互设计经验；热爱游戏设计和游戏行业，关注行业变化； 
2. 对设计问题有敏锐的洞察力，符合潮流的审美标准，对艺术有执着的追求；
3. 有丰富的游戏交互设计经验，良好的需求把握和逻辑分析能力，能对优秀游戏的交互方式进行深度分析，并且能制定出更好优化改进方案； 
4. 具有深厚的设计理论与娴熟的设计技巧，善于捕捉流行趋势，有完整跟进成熟游戏项目经验优先；
5. 具有优秀的沟通能力和团队协作能力，富有工作激情、创作欲望和责任感，能承受高强度的工作压力； 
6. 熟练使用Photoshop、AE等相关软件，掌握界面原型、流程、动效的交互设计方法； 
7. 有较丰富的单机游戏体验，尤其在动作冒险和角色扮演向作品方面有深刻体验，总体验时长不低于200小时，体验作品数量不少于8部。 1. 根据策划需求，协助设计出合理的交互解决方案，从功能和形式等多个方面协助提升设计质量；
2. 配合开发制作，与美术、程序合作将交互功能开发上线； 
3. 能够深入分析评估一套系统的用户体验、界面设计优缺点，并为游戏交互操作和情感体验提升提供参考或优化方向； 
4. 除了纯UI向的交互工作，还能够在单机体验层面的交互上去深入，定义单机交互全新维度； 
5. 能与上下游职位良好配合，把握需求，向视觉设计师和程序沟通传递设计思想； 
6. 具备较好的原型制作能力，能够使用ue5制作简单的原型资源和简单动效。

title: 下沉市场-招商运营
jd_text:
1. 招商线索获取：
-搭建并持续优化招商线索获取渠道体系，负责线索的挖掘、清洗、分级与转化跟踪，提升线索数量与质量双指标；
-通过新媒体矩阵（公众号、视频号、抖音、小红书、行业社群等）策划并执行招商获客内容，持续产出招商线索；
-设计并落地线索转化路径（内容触达 → 留资 → 分发 → 跟进），与招商团队协同，提升线索到商机的转化率。
2. 新媒体运营：
-负责面向商家/品牌方/合作商等目标客群的新媒体账号运营，制定内容规划并落地执行；
-策划行业洞察、招商政策解读、成功案例等内容专题，建立品牌在招商侧的影响力与信任感；
-监测内容数据与线索归因，迭代内容策略与投放策略。
3. 运营增长：
-基于数据驱动，设计并实验线索增长玩法（裂变活动、私域运营、直播招商会、异业合作等）；
-搭建招商线索数据看板，定期复盘渠道 ROI，优化预算与人力投放；
-探索新的获客渠道与增长模式，形成可复制的方法论。 1. 本科及以上学历，3年以上运营相关经验，有招商、加盟、B端获客或线索增长经验者优先；
2. 具备完整的新媒体运营经验，熟悉主流平台的内容打法与流量机制，有可量化的涨粉/获客/转化成果；
3. 具备运营增长思维，熟悉 A/B 测试、漏斗分析、私域运营等增长方法论，数据敏感度高；
4. 优秀的跨团队协作与推动能力，能与招商、销售、市场团队高效配合；
5. 加分项：有本地生活、零售连锁、商业地产等行业资源或招商经验。

jd_text:

- 走访客户，洞察产品开发方向；
- 厂牌研究，挖掘产品优化提升点；
- 数据分析，寻找产品开发机会；
- 立项汇报，制定产品可落地行动方案。

2.供应链开发方面：
- 开发源头集采工厂，实现链路最优；
- 掌握影响商品成本的原料行情波动情况；
- 不断优化现有供应商供应链路与成本；
- 负责供应商商务谈判，制定合作条款，管理供应商履约行为，与供应商建立长期稳定的合作关系。

3.产品运营方面：
- 对产品的销售额、利润、客户满意度等核心业绩目标负责；
- 针对关键的业绩指标和输入指标，进行每日的数据跟踪；
- 对于各项指标理解清晰，能够及时复盘，发现问题并制定有效的解决方案，推动异常问题的高效解决。 1.大学专科及以上学历，商品与供应链管理、采购管理等相关专业优先。
2.具有5年以上半熟调PB产品采购经验，熟悉行业供应商和市场情况。
3.具有较强的谈判能力、沟通能力和团队管理能力，能有效协调内外部资源。
4.具有破冰能力，能与陌生客户形成沟通协作关系。
5.能适应经常出差且具备移动办公能力。

4.适应互联网行业的快速发展，精力充沛，心态积极进取，有较强的目标意识及自驱力；

title: Director of Engineering, Database Excellence
jd_text:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.     An overview of this role  
 As Director of Engineering, Database Excellence, you will lead the Database Excellence stage and report to the Vice President of Data Engineering, in our Engineering department. You will set the direction for the databases that support GitLab.com, self-managed GitLab, and GitLab Dedicated. Your organization owns the reliability, capacity, health, and sustainability of GitLab's application datastores, with PostgreSQL as the primary focus alongside Redis, OpenSearch, ClickHouse, and object storage. 
 You will be accountable for database capacity and availability on GitLab.com. You will guide long-range platform decisions while partnering with Infrastructure, Product, Distribution, Support, Security, and FinOps. The work includes reducing infrastructure costs, improving data growth controls and saturation detection, standardizing database services, rebuilding the self-managed upgrade experience, and contributing to GitLab's company-wide datastore strategy, including Cells partitioning. Learn more in the  Database Excellence handbook . 
  What you’ll do  
 
 Set direction and long-range plans for the database platform in line with company strategy. 
 Own database capacity and availability outcomes for GitLab.com, and communicate database risk to senior leadership. 
 Lead and coach three Engineering Managers and develop Staff-plus engineers into leaders. 
 Drive cross-division technical decisions using data, partnering with Infrastructure, Product, Distribution, Support, Security, and FinOps. 
 Partner with Product to prioritize database platform investments and make infrastructure tradeoffs in the context of product outcomes. 
 Own the hiring plan, organization design, retention, and performance management for teams across regions. 
 Set quarterly objectives and key results and engineering key performance indicators for the stage, and manage the database infrastructure budget with FinOps. 
 Serve as an escalation point for database incidents, standardize effective processes, and keep the handbook current. 
 
  What you’ll bring  
 
 Experience leading managers of managers, including coaching newer managers. 
 Experience working hands-on with PostgreSQL at scale, including capacity planning, upgrades, replication, performance, and large production clusters. 
 Experience using data to make strategic technical decisions and connect database platform investments and tradeoffs with product outcomes. 
 Experience supporting software that customers run themselves, or working through the self-managed upgrade challenge. 
 Experience leading backend engineering teams

 As a Staff Enterprise Architect, you will design and evolve how GitLab's internal systems are configured, integrate, perform and scale to support a rapidly growing business.  Redesign workflows before automating them, so we aren't encoding broken processes into new tooling. For each step, decide what an AI agent should handle, what deterministic automation should handle, and what stays with a person.

 As an AI Transformation Owner at GitLab, you'll shape your function's AI strategy and build the solutions that deliver it. You are the person responsible for identifying where AI can fundamentally change how your org operates, partnering with your Executive Sponsor to align on the biggest challenges, and driving measurable outcomes against them. 
 Think of this as a product management role where the product is your org's way of working. You'll manage the full lifecycle: understanding how work flows today, deciding where AI should reshape it, prioritizing what gets built and in what order, and ensuring what ships actually gets adopted. You'll also prototype solutions, configure agents, and prove what's possible before pulling in engineering support to scale it. 
 You will work closely with an AI Engineer who sits within the Enterprise AI team. Together you form a partnership: you bring the business context, process intelligence, and strategic prioritization. They bring the technical depth, production-grade delivery, and architecture decisions. You'll build working solutions at the no-code and low-code layer, and partner with the AI Engineer on the right approach, tooling, and structure.

Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.    An overview of this role 
 The Trusted Agentic Development team sits within GitLab's Developer Experience group and builds the platforms our own engineers rely on every day. GitLab engineers increasingly build software with artificial intelligence (AI) agents. Agents generate code and tests in seconds, so speed is no longer the constraint. Confidence is. Agents can produce a passing test suite for software that doesn't work as intended, and a reviewer may not be able to tell the difference without redoing the work by hand. 
 As Engineering Manager, Trusted Agentic Development, you'll build and lead the team that closes this gap. You'll help define what validation means when the author is an agent and make the feedback loop fast, automatic, and trustworthy. You'll point the team at the right version of an open problem and earn adoption across GitLab by building the best path, not by mandating a process. 
 
 Validation that confirms agent-generated code does what was intended, so a passing suite means a working feature and not just a satisfied proxy. 
 Mid-loop feedback that helps an agent self-correct toward working software instead of green assertions. 
 Language-aware approaches under one shared model of what "trusted" means, starting with Rust, Ruby, and Go, while allowing the right technique to differ by language. 
 Real measurement of whether engineers trust and adopt the path, with findings fed directly back into the platform. 
 
 What you'll do 
 
 Build and grow the team by hiring and developing engineers who practice agentic development, and create a culture that treats this as an open problem to solve rather than a process to enforce. 
 Set direction in an undefined space by partnering with your team to shape the technical approach for validating agent-built software. 
 Keep the team focused on the highest-impact version of the problem rather than the easiest one. 
 Earn adoption by building relationships with engineering teams across GitLab, learning how they work with agents today, and creating a platform they choose because it makes them faster and more confident. 
 Measure engineer adoption and trust through real usage, treat adopters as design partners, and use findings to prioritize where confidence is breaking down. 
 Stay close to the technical work by engaging in architecture and design discussions, reviewing proposals, and keeping your judgment current as agentic development changes. 
 Run the team with clear goals, direct feedback, honest performance management, and ownership of complex work from planning through completion without relying on a dedicated program

 The Trusted Agentic Development team sits within GitLab's Developer Experience group and builds the platforms our engineers rely on every day. GitLab engineers increasingly build software with artificial intelligence agents. Agents can generate code and tests in seconds, but they can also produce passing test suites for software that doesn't work as intended. As a Senior Backend Engineer, Trusted Agentic Development, you'll own the technical thesis for closing that validation gap and build the early proof yourself. You'll rethink what validation means when the author is an agent and make the feedback loop fast, automatic, and trustworthy enough that teams choose to adopt it. 
 
 Validation that confirms agent-generated code does what was intended, so a passing suite means a working feature and not just a satisfied proxy. 
 Mid-loop feedback that helps an agent self-correct toward working software instead of green assertions. 
 Language-aware approaches under one shared model of what "trusted" means, starting with Rust, Ruby, and Go, while allowing the right technique to differ by language. 
 Real measurement of whether engineers trust and adopt the path, fed straight back into the platform. 
 
 What you’ll do 
 
 Own the technical thesis for how GitLab validates software when an agent is the author, and turn it into an architecture the team can build against. 
 Prototype the hard parts by building early versions of feedback mechanisms that catch the gap between passing tests and working software, proving what works before the team scales it. 
 Develop approaches for GitLab's primary stacks, starting with Rust, Ruby, and Go, under one shared definition of "trusted," while allowing the right technique to differ by language. 
 Design the mid-loop feedback an agent needs to self-correct toward working software rather than green assertions, and build the systems that deliver it. 
 Collaborate with engineering teams to adopt these approaches, measure adoption, engineer trust, and validation quality, and use those findings to improve the platform. 
 Set technical direction the team can build on, review designs, and help teammates grow their technical judgment. 
 
 What you’ll bring 
 
 Deep, current, hands-on experience building real software with artificial intelligence agents, ideally across more than one language, and a clear understanding of why agent output can pass tests yet fail in production.

Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.     An overview of this role  
 Site Reliability Engineers keep GitLab's user-facing services and production systems running reliably at scale. They combine software engineering with operational excellence, applying sound engineering principles, automation, and continuous improvement to build, operate, and evolve our production infrastructure. 
 This is a single application for Site Reliability Engineering opportunities across Infrastructure Platforms. Rather than asking you to choose the right team or level upfront, we evaluate your skills holistically and match you to the opportunity that best aligns with your experience and our hiring needs. We hire Site Reliability Engineers from Intermediate through Senior Staff across multiple Infrastructure Platforms teams. 
 We don't expect every candidate to have experience with every technology in our environment. We're looking for engineers with strong technical fundamentals, a growth mindset, and the ability to learn quickly. We'll support you in becoming successful with GitLab's tools, systems, and ways of working. 
   Please note: This position is open to candidates based in the United States and Canada only. Candidates based in the United Kingdom can apply to this posting:   Site Reliability Engineer, Infrastructure Platforms — UK (Intermediate to Senior Staff)   
  How our SRE hiring works  
 Because this is a single application for SRE roles across Infrastructure Platforms, our process is built to evaluate you once and match you well, rather than interviewing separately for every team. 
 
  Recruiter Screen:  A conversation about your background, what you're looking for, and the level and teams that fit, so we can point your process in the right direction. 
  Core Technical:  The shared assessment every SRE candidate takes, regardless of eventual team. A low-stress, collaborative discussion covering system architecture and incident review. 
  Hiring Manager Interview:  A conversation about ownership, judgment, execution, collaboration, and growth, the non-technical signals that make an SRE effective at GitLab. 
  Peer Technical:  Team-specific depth, run by SREs from the team you're most likely to join, focused on the problems that team actually works on. 
  Skip-Level Interview:  A conversation with a senior leader on values alignment, and how you'll work across teams. 
 
 After your interviews, we consider your performance alongside our current hiring needs to confirm the level and team where you'll do your best work. Interview results are a major factor, and final placement also reflects our active hiring priorities at the time.

 As a Demo Architect, you'll help GitLab teams and customers get hands-on with our platform faster and with less friction. This role reports to the Senior Director of our Solutions Architecture Center of Excellence, with day-to-day partnership from the current team lead. You'll build and improve the tools, applications, and infrastructure that support field team demos, workshops, trials, and internal test environments across the field.  
 What makes this role unique is its mix of software engineering, infrastructure, and customer-facing collaboration. You'll work like an engineer for much of the role, while also partnering with Solutions Architects, Account Executives, Customer Success, and others to make sure what we build is practical, usable, and aligned to how the field sells. 
  What you'll do  
 
 Build and maintain tools, applications, and workflows that support demos, workshops, trials, and internal test environments.

 Learn and document go-to-market workflows (e.g., how teams run demos/workshops/trials) and automate the steps that waste time. 
 Create technical workshop assets and enablement content that support pre-sales and technical selling for individual contributors. 
 Advise on sales opportunities when specialized technical demo support or custom solutions are needed. 
 Improve the presenter experience by reducing manual setup work and making demo workflows easier to use and repeat.

jd_text:
1、负责飞书产品与相关活动的视频设计制作，涵盖创意发散、画面叙事、视频执行输出等内容，精准传达品牌、产品与活动信息，提升产品整体视觉调性与品牌认知；
2、能参与视频全流程，独立对接业务方，结合业务洞察与目标进行从需求对接、脚本分镜策划，到2D/3D动效视频制作交付；
3、有AIGC参与执行流程经验，紧跟AI及视觉趋势，能推动设计驱动创新的实施实践；

title: 《逆战：未来》交互设计师
jd_text:
1.根据现有版本内容框架，负责游戏的交互设计拓展及战斗玩法体验的持续优化；
2.与跨职能团队合作，从交互专业角度创新高效地提出游戏设计方案；
3.跟进UI界面设计的各阶段，从方案概念到视觉设计，从界面开发到最终的功能验证；
4.运用线框图、故事板、用户流程等工具，有效传达交互和设计思路；
5.持续对游戏内容进行用户研究，收集体验反馈并输出优化方案，以提升玩家体验；
6.完善交互规范细则，持续提升项目交互设计品质。

- 基于叙事需求，输出符合世界观、游戏动机的分镜，把控情绪和氛围；

title: 跨境自营采购（美妆/食品） - 抖音电商
jd_text:
团队介绍：抖音电商以“总能发现好东西”为主张，致力于成为用户发现丰富好物的首选平台。众多抖音创作者通过短视频、直播、商城等丰富的形式，给用户提供更个性化、更生动、更高效的消费体验。同时，抖音电商积极引入优质合作伙伴，为商家变现提供多元的选择。

1、负责美妆或食品类目选品、采购及供应商管理，对销售、毛利和用户体验负责；
2、制定采购与定价策略，推进商务谈判、成本优化及营销活动；
3、关注库存周转、商品品质和履约表现。

title: 游戏视觉设计师 - Bluesea Studio
jd_text:
团队介绍：Bluesea工作室成立于2024年8月，当前涉足卡牌/RPG/SLG/竞技等多个品类，已经上线的游戏《放置少女》，各类新产品已蓄势待发。欢迎加入我们！

1、参与游戏UI整体视觉风格设计，视觉标准建立，完成UI相关的界面设计和图标绘制等，能够有效把控风格，做出有创新度和市场竞争力的设计；
2、统筹整理UI规范，提升设计细节品质，跟进外部供应商的合作，把控设计质量；
3、与交互、VX、重构、策划等团队紧密配合，共同优化需求方案，产出具备市场竞争力的游戏UX设计，提升玩家体验；
4、跟进UI设计在最终游戏中的实现效果，保证实现品质和设计品质的一致。

title: 高级/资深场景原画（代号对决） - Bluesea Studio
jd_text:
团队介绍：Bluesea工作室成立于2024年8月，当前涉足卡牌/RPG/SLG/竞技等多个品类，已经上线的游戏《放置少女》，各类新产品已蓄势待发。欢迎加入我们！

1、负责场景关卡地图沙盘的规划设计；
2、负责场景气氛图的表现刻画；
3、负责场景单体三视图的设计与拆解；
4、负责场景建筑部件规则的拆分与组合；
5、负责场景原画外包沟通与品质把控。

title: 角色原画（代号对决）-Bluesea - Bluesea Studio
jd_text:
团队介绍：Bluesea工作室成立于2024年8月，当前涉足卡牌/RPG/SLG/竞技等多个品类，已经上线的游戏《放置少女》，各类新产品已蓄势待发。欢迎加入我们！

1、负责射击游戏的角色相关设计，包括但不限于英雄设计、主题皮肤设计、武器设计、特效设计等工作，确保原画设计产出符合游戏世界观调性与标准；
2、跟进审核外包产出，把控外包交付的质量与进度；
3、与策划、模型、动作、特效协作，跟进原画从设计到最终效果的落地、迭代和优化，解决落地过程中的美术问题，确保设计的还原度；
4、配合项目进行美术风格迭代，沉淀设计经验，编写设计文档，总结设计方法论。

title: J3-UE5动作游戏-角色原画设计
jd_text:
1.负责游戏角色、怪物、武器、商业化时装等高品质概念设计；
2.与设计团队密切合作，定义角色美术方向，输出高质量的设计并把控角色设计的一致性；
3.与上下游以及内外部合作团队紧密协作，保持高效的设计沟通与反馈，激发创意。

title: 《王者荣耀》2D分镜动画导演
jd_text:
1.负责王者荣耀官方英雄&皮肤出场动画前期2D设计和执导工作；
2.与王者荣耀动画特效团队以及其他环节同事配合创作；
3.与外部制作团队沟通对接，共同完成英雄皮肤的创作。

title: Supercell游戏《荒野乱斗》-资深动画设计师
jd_text:
1.负责荒野乱斗游戏内角色表演、场景及技能动画的设计与制作；
2.根据游戏策划需求，完成高质量动画资源，确保欧美动画风格与游戏整体美术风格一致；
3.与游戏策划、程序团队紧密协作，优化动画性能，提升游戏体验；
4.参与动画设计规范的制定与维护，提升团队整体动画制作效率；
5.持续关注行业动态，探索创新动画表现形式，为游戏带来独特视觉效果。

title: 3D动作游戏《狩》-3D动画专家（深圳/上海）
jd_text:
1.负责游戏中角色的动画制作，包括战斗与表演动画；
2.负责游戏中怪物的动画制作，包括四足、鸟类、鱼类等怪物制作战斗与表演动画；
3.负责游戏中过场动画制作，通过分镜或者原著参考还原3D动画；
4.跟进和反馈外包进度，按时完成需求。

title: 游戏技术美术（动画向）
jd_text:
1、5年以上的游戏业界技术动画从业经验
2、熟练使用一个或多个动画生产工具，例如 Maya，MotionBuilder，3dsmax 等。 
3、能够使用美术工具中的脚本语言开发工具。例如 MEL，MaxScript 或 Python。
4、能够在游戏引擎中进行动画功能，和程序化动画开发者优先。
5、对动画原理理解深入，有能力制定游戏的动画技术方案和优化动画效果

 1、引入和整合业界最新的技术，提升从动画生产到引擎中最终呈现，整个过程中的效率和质量。
2、负责引擎中动画相关的技术支持、指导与研发。帮助改进自研引擎动画系统和编辑器。
3、 规划和定义未来游戏动画研发工作流和技术规范。建立相关标准与规则。
4、对镜头表现、相机动画、角色操作体验有一定的审美与想法。
5、良好的学习与钻研能力，关注行业前沿，快速跟进新技术。
6、为动画美术开发各类工具，协助美术提高动画的制作质量和效率，解决遇到的各类技术问题。

title: 角色原画设计师（归唐）
jd_text:
1. 擅长叙事类角色设计，以及写实题材者优先；
2. 优秀的角色性格把控能力和丰富的人文知识储备。
3. 多年成型项目游戏制作经验
4. 善于表达和分享技术成果，能够启发和引领团队人员对角色的导向性理解和运用。 1. 参与游戏前期世界观构建，负责设计游戏项目角色风格，制定风格标准。
2. 负责概念设计以及设计任务的分析分解。

title: 美团外卖-供应链采购专家
jd_text:
1、寻商：基于用户需求预测，输出品类备货计划，根据上游菜品研发的食材清单要求和标准，寻找匹配需求的工厂、供应商。
2、菜品：联动菜品研发，与供应商研发对接，进行定品和议价，输出采购方案，持续推动商品统采。
3、议价：通过竞标等流程，拿到供应商最优价格，并持续原料采购价格优化。
4、供应商管理：联动品控，对合作商的产品做品质监督管理，保障商品稳定性，以及联动商管，通过商管政策对合作商继续做合规化管理，保障供应链的高效运转。 
5、履约仓储对接：对接供应商、仓配厂商，推动履约链路搭建，保障商品从工厂到门店的履约时效和效率、成本最优。 1、大学本科及以上学历。
2、在餐饮品牌、食材供应链平台等，从事零售3R大单品等优先，有采购经验。
3、有供应链资源。
4、具备创业精神，积极主动，有较强的自驱力。
